body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Haier launched its first generation LED TV lineup at CES 2010, which is available in 46", 40", 32", 24", 22" and 19" screen sizes.

The 19" and 22" models are shipping in January and the other sizes shortly after. The 46" and 40" measure in at just 1.2" thick and the TV cabinets are available in a high gloss piano black cabinet for a smooth, sexy look or a high gloss white cabinet for a modern luxury appearance. Haier's Edge-lit LED technology paired with full HD 1080p and 120Hz Full Motion refresh rate, offers amazing picture quality with true-to-life colors without motion blur.
In addition, SRS TruSurround XT technology gives any movie a live-performance quality that makes any movie night, a night to remember.

"With the introduction of our ultra slim LED HDTV's and the full assortment of our LCD HDTV product lines, Haier now offers a full array of TV products ranging from fun, colorful models for kid's rooms, elegant designs for the kitchen, to the home theater centerpiece," said Michael Jemal, Chairman of the Board for Haier America. "Haier always strives for more environmentally friendly products, and we are proud that the 24", 22" and 19" LED's are rated ENERGY STAR® 4.0."

One of the new technologies available in 2010 is Haier's USB TimeShift function. This exciting addition allows users to have complete control of their viewing experience. Pause, rewind, or fast forward the program you are watching. Simply connect a USB drive to the USB input – different size USB memory will give you different time length to playback. Easily pause to get a snack, fast forward through commercials and press play.
Haier's LED line will be available the first half of 2010 with the following model numbers and MSRP:
46" HL46XSL2 (Black), HL46XSLW2 (White) - $1,499.99
40" HL40XSL2 (Black), HL40XSLW2 (White) - $1,199.99
32" HL32XSL2 (Black), HL32XSLW2 (White) - $799.99
24" HL24XSL2 (Black), HL24XSLW2 (White) - $329.99
22" HL22XSL2 (Black), HL22XSLW2 (White) - $299.99
19" HL19SL2 (Black), HL19SLW2 (White) - $249.99
The 2010 Haier CES introductions for television include the following series:
K-Series

The 55" K-Series is the largest screen Haier has ever offered in the US. The impressive 55" 1080p 120Hz LCD TV has all the features you would need for a full-time entertainment system, without the bulk. Go from video games, to pictures from your computer, to an action movie with just your remote.

The centerpiece of Haier's K-Series is the 42" HL42XZK42 flat-screen LCD TV that boasts the fastest refresh rate in the Haier line with 240Hz Full Motion. Along with the precise picture, the hidden Sound Chamber speaker includes SRS TruSurround XT and has an Auto Volume Leveler with distortion control, so you are hearing clear sound, without background noise.
LCD and LED HDTV Combos

Haier is also introducing several new combo units. The K-Series 32" LCD TV with Blu-ray /DVD combo, HLB32XK2, is the ultimate in entertainment. The Blu-ray combo has the ability to play DVD or Blu-ray discs, and features a built-in wifi connection and Adobe® Flash® for the Digital Home to support streaming movies in HD or DVD quality directly from pre-installed applications built with Adobe Flash technology like Netflix and Pandora, all powered by Broadcom's chipset.
Haier's LED TV Combos come in 24", 22" and 19" screen sizes. Get all the pluses of the LED line, including a built-in DVD player for space saving and convenience for you.
F-Series

The Designer F-Series LCD 22" screen is perfect for any bedroom, office, dorm room or kitchen. The unique teardrop design with compact cabinet offers space-saving style that fits comfortably into smaller areas Available in stylish high gloss cabinet colors - black, white and pink
D-Series

Ranging from family room sized 42" to space-saving 19" screens; the D-Series is perfect for the budget conscious consumer who wants to upgrade their TV experience with all the bells and whistles of a high-priced flat-screen. With extras like HDMI input, component input, PC and USB hook-ups as well as AV input, you can get a whole range of entertainment possibilities with one TV.
